description: This file defines the StoreCacheManagerImpl class, which manages cache for store-related data by extending CacheManagerImpl. It implements the singleton pattern to provide a single instance of the cache manager.

classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing store cache, extending the generic CacheManagerImpl.
